27:23.text: "I found a woman ruling over them: she has been given all things that could be possessed by any ruler of the earth, and she has a great throne.

27:24.text: "I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allâh, and Shaitân
has made their deeds fair-seeming to them, and has barred them from
Way: so they have no guidance."

27:25.text: [As Shaitân (Satan) has barred them from Allâh’s Way]
Allâh, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

27:26.text: (none has the right to be worshipped but He)
, the Lord of the Supreme Throne!

27:28.text: "Go you with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them, then draw back from them, and see what

27:29.text: She said: "O chiefs! Verily! Here is delivered to me a noble letter,

27:30.text: : In the Name of Allâh, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful:

27:31.text: "Be you not exalted against me, but come to me as Muslims
(true believers who submit to Allâh with full submission)

27:32.text: She said: "O chiefs! Advise me in
case of mine. I decide no case till you are present with me

27:33.text: They said: "We have great strength, and great ability for war, but it is for you to command: so think over what you will command."

27:34.text: She said: "Verily kings, when they enter a town
, they despoil it and make the most honourable amongst its people the lowest. And thus they do.
